# Pragvance.ai

> Practical AI. Built to advance your business.

Pragvance helps you staff a Grok Bot department — roles, skills, tools, routines — and ships apps & SaaS when the work needs a product.

## Offers

  Weekly live training to build a Grok Bot agent team. Classroom stays on Skool.

  Live high-touch seats. Not a second school on this site.

- Apps: portfolio including MinutesIntel.ai (https://minutesintel.ai); custom builds via contact

## AI Spin Up
- Page: https://pragvance.ai/ai-spin-up
- Aliases that 308 to that page: /spin-up, /hi, /talk-to-an-ai-agent
- What it is: an AI voice agent for small business from Pragvance. A business owner gets an AI agent speaking in their voice. The agent talks with prospects who reach out from an ad or a call and books a call with the owner.
- Setup: a 5-10 minute interview. The agent stays inside the owner's service area.
- Steps: They reach out. The agent trades information. They book a call with you. You get the summary.
- Coming soon: the post-call summary email, the missed-call text back, and the weekly digest.
- Talk to an AI Spin Up agent: https://connect-now-landing.vercel.app/
- See plans: the same AI Spin Up site. This page does not list a price.
- Tagline: Practical AI. Built to advance your business.
